about: Red Deer sits on the Red Deer River in central Alberta, roughly halfway between Calgary and Edmonton on the Queen Elizabeth II Highway. It is a regional service and energy-sector city with a long connected park system along Waskasoo Creek. The surrounding county remains agricultural. About 101,000 people live in Red Deer.
